concept.title: Which file to send
concept.shortdesc: Send the copy you saved yourself, because the file you chose does not hold your new work.

conbody.p: To share your tree, send a copy that you saved with . shows how to make one.
Do not send the file you chose when you opened your tree. did not change it, so it does not show your new work. The copy that works on is not a file you can send.
A saved copy stays as it was when you made it. Make a new one before you send, if you have added anything since.
